name.pt-BR: São Simão e São Judas Tadeu

patronOf.en-US: Apostles; St. Jude, patron of hopeless causes
patronOf.pt-BR: Apóstolos; São Judas, padroeiro das causas impossíveis

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Beloved, build yourselves up in your most holy faith.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Caríssimos, edificai-vos sobre a vossa santíssima fé.

meta.face: Simon: an old man around 70, bald, with a neat rounded white beard. Jude: a young man around 28 with a young light brown beard.
meta.basis: Simon old and bald with a rounded beard; Jude young with a young beard (Painter's Manual). Attributes: Simon's bucksaw; Jude's halberd, medallion of Christ's face and flame.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: The card previously held a second image of St. Gianna by mistake; generated anew from the Philip & James and Cecilia cards as style references
